name: document_read
description: Read one page of rows from one part of one document. Rows keep their file order and are numbered from 0; row 0 is the header. The document does not fit in one page, so pick the page with offset. Do not page through it to find a row: use the row count and the first and last row that document_list reported to estimate the row's number, jump straight to that offset, and correct from what comes back.

document.description: File name as document_list reported it; omit if the task has one

part.description: Part name as document_list reported it; omit for the first

offset.description: Row number of the first row to return

limit.description: How many rows; default 50, a byte ceiling may return fewer
